messages:
julia: Heads-up: rolling out a new opt-in preview channel for SDKs and a small docs policy tweak. Short summary below. :rocket:

sanjay: quick q 1: does preview mean nightly artifacts or weekly?

julia: preview = nightly builds pushed to rw-sdk@preview; we also tag a weekly stable-preview snapshot for those who want fewer churns. No automatic upgrades.

marco: docs policy tweak?

julia: yes 1: any docs PR that touches API surface or SDK examples must include a CHANGES entry (one-line) and a migration note (if applicable). CI will warn if missing.

audrey-docs: UI note: we updated the interactive playground to include a toggle "Use preview SDK builds" and a small hint about staging vs prod. Snippets saved before the change will continue to work.

marco: ops note: preview builds enable an opt-in batching heuristic. Enable via config snippet: ```yaml
client: 
  channel: preview
  batching: 
    heuristic: experimental
```

legal-ali: please make sure telemetry opt-in language is explicit. For enterprise orgs the default must be opt-out and we need a clear checkbox in the UI.

audrey-docs: added to PR checklist. We'll include the checkbox in the playground and an example config showing opt-out.

ops-bot: deploy: preview artifacts published -> rw-sdk@preview-20260302 (sha:deadbeef)

julia: rollout plan: day 0 publish preview + UI toggle; day 2 console banner to active projects; day 7 stricter CI check enforced.

marco: action items: 1) docs team adds CHANGES.md template and example migration note; 2) eng adds CI warning rule; 3) legal reviews telemetry wording.

julia: thanks all. If you want to test: `rw-sdk install --channel preview` and please open any regressions in #eng-runtime.
